review_text: Absolutely amazing experience! The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Our server Emily was attentive and knowledgeable. Will definitely be coming back!
Best pasta I've ever had in my life. The ambiance was cozy and romantic. Perfect for date night. Highly recommend the truffle risotto!
Wonderful evening overall. The chef's special was outstanding and the wine pairing suggestions were spot on. Just a tiny wait but worth every minute.
Outstanding service from start to finish. The staff remembered it was our anniversary and surprised us with a complimentary dessert. Truly touched.
Great food and a lively atmosphere. The grilled salmon was cooked to perfection. Portions are generous and prices are reasonable.
Phenomenal! Every dish we ordered was absolutely delicious. The garlic bread was crispy, the steak was juicy. Five stars, no question.
Came here for my birthday and it was perfect. The staff sang to me and the lava cake was divine. An unforgettable night!
Solid experience. The menu has great variety and the kitchen clearly takes pride in what they serve. The soup was rich and hearty.
I've been to many restaurants but this one stands out. The flavors were so complex and well balanced. The ambiance was elegant without being stuffy.
The service was impeccable. Our waiter Jacob went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. The food matched the service perfectly.
Really enjoyed the tasting menu. Every course was a pleasant surprise. The wine list is extensive and the sommelier is very helpful.
Hands down the best burger in the city. The buns are freshly baked and the patty is seasoned perfectly. The fries are crispy and seasoned well too.
What a gem! Hidden in a quiet street but absolutely worth seeking out. The owner greets every guest personally and the food is made with love.
Very pleasant dining experience. The staff was friendly and efficient. Loved the mushroom risotto and the creme brulee was flawless.
Exceeded all my expectations! The decor is stunning and the food is just as beautiful. Each dish felt like art on a plate.
Great spot for a business lunch. Quick service, excellent food, and a quiet enough atmosphere to have proper conversations. The seafood linguine was divine.
We had the Sunday brunch and it was sensational. The eggs benedict were perfectly poached and the freshly squeezed juice was so refreshing.
The attention to detail here is extraordinary. From the hand-written menus to the locally sourced ingredients. This place is a true culinary experience.
Lovely place for a family dinner. Kids menu is thoughtful and delicious. My daughter loved the mini pizzas and I thoroughly enjoyed the lamb chops.
Simply magical. The chef came out to greet us personally and explained each dish. The flavors were unlike anything I've tasted before.
Every single time I come here, it's consistently excellent. That kind of reliability is rare. The chicken piccata never disappoints.
Very good food and a great atmosphere. The live jazz on Fridays adds a special touch. The ribeye was cooked exactly to my specification.
I brought my parents here and they absolutely loved it. The service was warm, the food was delicious, and the pricing felt very fair.
One of the best dining experiences I've had this year. The degustation menu is a must-try. Every pairing was thoughtful and inspired.
Consistently good food and friendly staff. The seasonal menu keeps things interesting. The autumn squash soup was incredibly comforting.
Just incredible. The atmosphere is welcoming and the food is absolutely top tier. The slow-cooked short ribs were fall-off-the-bone tender.
A lovely Saturday dinner. The starters were inventive and the mains were beautifully executed. Good cocktail menu too.
Best Italian outside of Italy! The pasta is house-made and you can taste the difference. The tiramisu was the best I've ever had.
Incredible date night experience. The lighting, the music, the food - everything was perfectly curated. We'll be celebrating every anniversary here.
Highly recommend the seafood platter. Fresh, generous, and reasonably priced. Great views and a relaxed vibe. Staff is friendly and attentive.
The chef's tasting menu was an absolute journey. Seven courses of pure brilliance. The presentation was stunning and every bite was memorable.
Great neighborhood spot. Always reliable. The burgers are juicy and the milkshakes are thick and creamy. Perfect for a casual dinner.
Exquisite dining experience. The service was flawless and the food was absolutely outstanding. The sommelier's recommendations were perfect.
Enjoyed the farm-to-table concept. You can really taste the freshness of the ingredients. The vegetarian options are creative and satisfying.
The brunch here is absolutely spectacular. The avocado toast was elevated to a whole new level and the bottomless mimosas were a nice touch.
I was blown away by the quality here. The kitchen clearly has a talented team. Every dish arrived perfectly timed and beautifully presented.
A delightful experience from beginning to end. Lovely staff, gorgeous interior, and food that genuinely surprised and delighted us.
The best meal I've had in years. The slow-roasted duck was phenomenal. The kitchen team clearly has a deep passion for what they do.
What a wonderful hidden gem! The menu is creative, the portions are generous, and the prices are very reasonable. Absolutely loved it.
The freshness of the ingredients really shines through every dish. Staff is warm, welcoming, and quick. Will definitely be returning soon.
Terrible experience from start to finish. Waited 45 minutes to be seated despite having a reservation. Food was cold and tasteless. Never coming back.
The steak I ordered was supposed to be medium-rare but arrived completely overcooked. When I complained, the waiter was dismissive and rude.
Found a hair in my pasta. The manager offered a discount but didn't seem genuinely concerned. The entire experience was off-putting.
Extremely disappointing. The menu looked great online but the actual dishes were nothing like the photos. Bland, small portions and overpriced.
Waited over an hour for our food. No apology from the staff. When the food finally came, it was lukewarm at best. Absolutely unacceptable.
The service was painfully slow. We had to ask three times for water. The food was mediocre at best. Not worth the price at all.
Shockingly bad. The fish smelled off and I ended up feeling sick afterward. The place was also dirty with sticky tables and a grimy floor.
Arrived to find our reservation had been lost. They squeezed us into a terrible corner table. The food was average and the noise level unbearable.
The soup was stone cold and the bread was stale. When I pointed this out, the server just shrugged. Zero effort to fix the problem.
Charged for items we never ordered and the manager refused to remove them from the bill. Felt like a scam. Will be disputing this charge.
Worst restaurant experience of my life. Rude staff, terrible food, dirty bathrooms. I genuinely cannot find a single positive thing to say.
The chicken was raw in the middle. Absolutely unacceptable and frankly dangerous. No real apology was given. I won't be returning.
The waiter spilled a drink on my partner and barely acknowledged it. No offer to pay for dry cleaning. Just a halfhearted sorry.
The fresh catch of the day tasted anything but fresh. It had a strong, unpleasant smell. For the price, I expected so much better.
Tables were dirty when we arrived and nobody came to clean them. The food was disappointing - overseasoned and poorly cooked.
Every dish was way too salty. My partner's dessert had visible mold on it. The staff acted like we were bothering them by pointing it out.
Booked this place for a special occasion and was completely let down. Wrong orders delivered, ice cold food, and zero customer care.
The vegan options described on the menu contained dairy - something I'm allergic to. When flagged, the server seemed confused and unhelpful.
Waited 20 minutes just to get a menu. Another 40 to get our food. The place was only half full. Simply no excuse for this level of service.
The pizza base was soggy and undercooked. The toppings were sparse and the sauce was watery. For 25 dollars, I expected far better.
Found the kitchen visibly unclean through the open-kitchen window. Lost my appetite immediately. Health inspectors should visit this place.
This place clearly doesn't care about its customers. Long waits, indifferent staff, and food that tastes like it came out of a microwave.
The cocktails were watered down and overpriced. The appetizers were a joke - tiny portions served on a massive plate with garnish as filler.
My dish arrived with a bug in it. I was horrified. The manager came over and offered a replacement but never apologized or discounted the bill.
Absolutely horrendous. The pasta was overcooked and mushy, the sauce had no flavor, and the portion was embarrassingly small for the price.
Reservations here are meaningless. We waited 35 minutes past our booking time. The meal itself was forgettable and overpriced.
The worst pizza I've ever eaten. Doughy, underseasoned, and served at room temperature. The server showed no interest in our experience at all.
Absolutely nothing about this meal was enjoyable. Cold food, rude staff, noisy environment, and prices that are completely unjustified.
Took 15 minutes just to get a glass of water. The burger was dry and the bun was stale. The fries were limp and cold. A complete waste of money.
Our server forgot half our order and showed zero remorse when we had to reorder. The food that did come was mediocre and arrived at different times.
The restrooms were absolutely disgusting - no soap, overflowing bins, and broken locks. It says a lot about how this place is run overall.
Ordered the lamb and received what looked like a different dish entirely. Complained but was told that's just how it's plated. Unbelievable.
Possibly the rudest staff I've ever encountered. Not a single smile. Made to feel like we were inconveniencing them just by being there.
The crab cakes were dry and tasted store-bought. Nothing about the meal felt fresh or homemade. Extremely underwhelming for a restaurant of this price range.
Three separate orders came out wrong. We waited over an hour in total. The manager offered nothing as compensation. I left genuinely upset.
The chicken dish had a bone fragment in it that nearly chipped my tooth. When I informed the server, she just apologized without taking it off the bill.
Zero stars if I could. The restaurant smelled musty when we entered. The food was bland and the service non-existent. A deeply unpleasant visit.
Waited an hour for our mains after a fast starter. The main course was cold and over-salted. Staff seemed overwhelmed and disorganized.
Ordered a vegetarian dish and it clearly had meat in it. A serious allergen concern that was brushed off by the manager. Completely unacceptable.
Came here based on online reviews and was massively disappointed. The food was stale, the atmosphere was dull, and the service was painfully slow.
